# rnnoise-wasm

`internal/web/views/static/rnnoise.wasm` is `dist/rnnoise.wasm` from
[@jitsi/rnnoise-wasm](https://github.com/jitsi/rnnoise-wasm) 0.2.1, an
Emscripten build of [RNNoise](https://github.com/xiph/rnnoise). The voice
client's `denoise.js` runs it in place of Jitsi's loader.
